directors.name: Shunji Iwai
directors.mood: Tender youthful longing, coming-of-age, fragile friendships and bittersweet memory
directors.composition: Loose intimate framing, empty space and lyrical handheld movement
directors.light: Airy backlight, blooming highlights, soft green daylight

directors.name: Hirokazu Kore-eda
directors.mood: Family, childhood, everyday intimacy and humanist social observation
directors.composition: Patient eye-level frames, domestic spaces and restrained observational coverage
directors.light: Soft window light, warm interiors and muted natural colors

directors.name: Wong Kar-wai
directors.mood: Urban loneliness, unspoken desire, fragmented memory and romantic melancholy
directors.composition: Frames within frames, intimate close-ups, step-printed motion and obscured sightlines
directors.light: Saturated crimson, jade interiors, neon spill and deep shadows

directors.name: Wes Anderson
directors.mood: Deadpan comedy, eccentric families, wistful adventure and playful social satire
directors.composition: Centered symmetry, flat theatrical staging, lateral tracking and miniature-like sets
directors.light: Soft even illumination, pastel color blocks and coordinated costumes

directors.name: Christopher Nolan
directors.mood: High-concept suspense, moral dilemmas, espionage, time and monumental spectacle
directors.composition: Large-format vistas, architectural scale, intercut timelines and grounded action
directors.light: Cool blue-grey tones, practical light and bold natural contrast

directors.name: Denis Villeneuve
directors.mood: Existential science fiction, isolation, slow tension and awe
directors.composition: Tiny figures against vast landscapes, brutalist geometry and negative space
directors.light: Atmospheric haze, controlled color fields, amber fog and steel-blue shadows

directors.name: David Fincher
directors.mood: Obsession, psychological tension, procedural crime and social alienation
directors.composition: Precisely controlled camera movement, calculated geometry and unsettling close-ups
directors.light: Low-key practical lighting, sickly yellow-green and dense clean blacks

directors.name: Joel & Ethan Coen
directors.mood: Black comedy, ordinary people in criminal chaos, fatalism and dry regional irony
directors.composition: Wide isolated figures, deliberate shot-reverse-shot and deadpan tableau
directors.light: Earth tones, bleak daylight and pools of practical interior light

directors.name: John Woo
directors.mood: Undercover identity, brotherhood, betrayal and operatic action
directors.composition: Balletic gunplay, slow motion, dynamic movement and face-to-face stand-offs
directors.light: Hard highlights, smoky interiors, saturated accents and cool urban tones

directors.name: Christopher McQuarrie
directors.mood: Espionage, shifting allegiances, ticking clocks and global high-stakes missions
directors.composition: Geographically legible action, practical stunts and tense close-up exchanges
directors.light: Clean daylight spectacle, cool shadows and naturalistic location lighting

directors.name: Tomas Alfredson
directors.mood: Cold War espionage, ambiguity, institutional paranoia and restrained emotion
directors.composition: Compressed telephoto spaces, obscured observers and meticulous period interiors
directors.light: Desaturated ochre, nicotine brown, overcast grey and soft practical pools

directors.name: Sam Mendes
directors.mood: Duty, loneliness, wartime danger and elegant spy suspense
directors.composition: Long continuous movement, silhouettes and architectural framing
directors.light: Dramatic practical sources, blue neon and golden firelight

directors.name: Sofia Coppola
directors.mood: Youthful isolation, privileged ennui, delicate romance and private inner worlds
directors.composition: Lingering portraits, dreamy negative space and detached observation
directors.light: Pastel haze, soft hotel light and luminous pale skin tones

directors.name: Richard Linklater
directors.mood: Everyday romance, youth, passing time and thoughtful human connection
directors.composition: Unhurried walking two-shots, conversational coverage and natural spaces
directors.light: Available light, soft evening warmth and unforced color

directors.name: Greta Gerwig
directors.mood: Coming-of-age, female friendship, family friction and playful social commentary
directors.composition: Energetic ensemble blocking, intimate character detail and expressive production design
directors.light: Warm nostalgic interiors or exuberant designed color depending on the story

directors.name: Bong Joon-ho
directors.mood: Social satire, class conflict, dark humor and sudden thriller turns
directors.composition: Architectural hierarchy, precise blocking and spatial contrasts
directors.light: Cool affluent interiors against warm crowded spaces, controlled contrast

directors.name: Park Chan-wook
directors.mood: Revenge, obsession, forbidden desire and morally ambiguous suspense
directors.composition: Graphic match cuts, elegant symmetry and elaborate point-of-view structures
directors.light: Jewel tones, sensual chiaroscuro and richly textured interiors

directors.name: Stanley Kubrick
directors.mood: Psychological unease, institutional power, dystopia and controlled absurdity
directors.composition: One-point perspective, exact symmetry and slow tracking through corridors
directors.light: Clinical light, bold primary colors or painterly candlelit period scenes

directors.name: Quentin Tarantino
directors.mood: Crime, revenge, pop-cultural irony and explosive black humor
directors.composition: Trunk-angle views, wide dialogue tableaux and sudden kinetic shifts
directors.light: Saturated primary accents, retro interiors and bold contrast

directors.name: Jean-Pierre Jeunet
directors.mood: Whimsical romance, eccentric characters and surreal dark comedy
directors.composition: Wide-angle close-ups, intricate interiors and storybook urban detail
directors.light: Golden warmth, saturated greens and reds, theatrical practical lighting

directors.name: Hayao Miyazaki
directors.mood: Childhood wonder, ecology, flight, courage and compassionate fantasy
directors.composition: Expansive hand-drawn landscapes, quiet everyday gestures and dynamic aerial space
directors.light: Lush natural greens, blue skies, painterly warmth and luminous magical light

directors.name: Makoto Shinkai
directors.mood: Teenage romance, separation, memory and fate across time
directors.composition: Detailed urban landscapes, skyward framing and intimate inserts
directors.light: Brilliant skies, glowing sunset, lens flare and saturated blue-pink light

directors.name: Guillermo del Toro
directors.mood: Dark fairy tales, outsiders, gothic romance and compassionate horror
directors.composition: Ornate environments, creature detail and fluid storybook camera movement
directors.light: Amber against cyan, gothic shadows and richly textured practical light

directors.name: Céline Sciamma
directors.mood: Queer romance, female solidarity, childhood identity and restrained desire
directors.composition: Patient portraits, exchanged looks and rigorous uncluttered compositions
directors.light: Soft coastal daylight, firelight and restrained painterly colors
